businesses.business: Check deposit and identity verification software

offering_description.value: Mitek sells mobile check deposit, check fraud detection, and digital identity verification software to banks, credit unions, fintechs, and other businesses. Customers integrate the software into their apps and workflows to process check images, verify identity documents, and authenticate users with biometrics.

primary_products.value: mobile check deposit software; check fraud detection software; identity document verification software; facial and voice biometric authentication software

primary_services.value: hosted identity verification; hosted check fraud screening; software implementation and integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit unions, fintechs, payment providers, and online marketplaces

end_markets.value: banking and credit unions; payments; fintech and digital lending; online marketplaces

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: licenses for mobile check deposit and related software; transaction or usage fees: check processing, fraud screening, and identity verification transactions; subscription: recurring access to hosted verification and fraud detection software; service fees: implementation and integration work
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: processes check images, identity documents, and biometric inputs for financial institutions and online businesses; service provider: integrates verification and check processing software into customer workflows

geography_served.value: global: North America, the United Kingdom, continental Europe, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: mobile check deposit, check fraud detection, digital identity verification, and biometric authentication

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales to financial institutions, fintechs, and online businesses; partners / resellers: core banking and digital banking vendors, payments processors, and identity technology partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: handling identity documents and biometrics under GDPR and applicable US privacy and biometric data laws
